system.description:
Represents physical strikes with fists, kicks, joint locks, and constriction of a target.

Melee weapons cannot be used past their Range limit. The book gives no tech level for melee weapons.

Can be thrown within short range.

Melee weapons cannot be used past their Range limit. The book gives no tech level for melee weapons.

Traits

  • Bladed: This weapon usage is modified by the Melee (Blade) Skill.
  • Conceal: This weapon can be concealed easily, granting +1DM when attempting to hide the weapon.
  • Throw: This weapon can be thrown up to x2 DEX metres.

A bludgeoning, one-handed weapon used by law enforcement or for self-defence.

Melee weapons cannot be used past their Range limit. The book gives no tech level for melee weapons.

Traits

  • Bludgeon: This weapon usage is modified by the Melee (Bludgeon) Skill.
  • One-Handed: This melee weapon can only be used in one-hand.

A one-handed sword; examples are sabers, rapiers, sideswords, etc.

Melee weapons cannot be used past their Range limit. The book gives no tech level for melee weapons.

Traits

  • Bladed: This weapon usage is modified by the Melee (Blade) Skill.
  • One-Handed: This melee weapon can only be used in one-hand.

A powerful weapon designed to be effective against eliminating targets effectively.

Melee weapons cannot be used past their Range limit. The book gives no tech level for melee weapons.

Traits

  • Bladed: This weapon usage is modified by the Melee (Blade) Skill.
  • Two-Handed: This melee weapon required two hands to use properly; otherwise incur -2DM.

A larger, two-handed version of a baton.

Melee weapons cannot be used past their Range limit. The book gives no tech level for melee weapons.

Traits

  • Bludgeon: This weapon usage is modified by the Melee (Bludgeon) Skill.
  • Two-Handed: This melee weapon required two hands to use properly; otherwise incur -2DM.

An effective self-defence and dueling weapon used amongst nobility.

Melee weapons cannot be used past their Range limit. The book gives no tech level for melee weapons.

Traits

  • Bladed: This weapon usage is modified by the Melee (Blade) Skill.
  • Two-Handed: This melee weapon required two hands to use properly; otherwise incur -2DM.

A long infantry weapon designed to keep targets at a distance while being deadly.

Melee weapons cannot be used past their Range limit. The book gives no tech level for melee weapons.

Traits

  • Bladed: This weapon usage is modified by the Melee (Blade) Skill.
  • Two-Handed: This melee weapon required two hands to use properly; otherwise incur -2DM.
  • Large: The weapon cannot be used in an area smaller than short distance without incurring -2DM.

Can be attached to a stocked gun to convert the gun into a melee weapon that deals 2D. (Two-Handed when equipped to a stocked gun.)

Melee weapons cannot be used past their Range limit. The book gives no tech level for melee weapons.

Traits

  • Bladed: This weapon usage is modified by the Melee (Blade) Skill.
  • Attachable: Can be mounted to a larger weapon to inflict the damage listed in parentheses.
